preconditions.description: The number of even steps a is between 0 and 100 inclusive.
The number of odd steps b is between 0 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if a + b > 0 and (a + b) % 2 == 1 and a == (a + b) // 2 else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if there exists an interval with a even and b odd steps, otherwise 'NO'.
